_doc: FAKE_LLM=1 answers for similarBarriers() (lib/ai/similar.ts, docs/domain.md §6.2). A topic applies when one of its `keywords` is a case-insensitive substring of THIS case's public summary; then every candidate whose summary holds one of the same topic's keywords is a match, with the topic's `reason`. Candidates keep their order (newest first), each listed once (the first topic that fits wins), at most 5. The answer then goes through the same check as a model's: every ref must be one of the candidates. Topics follow the seed and the e2e scenarios (doors, ramps, chat, labels, hearing loops); A more specific topic comes before a broader one (hearing loop before counter). Add topics, never rewrite one.
